questions.q: Total distance for the three-stage journey?
Gradient of a distance-time graph gives...
The area under a velocity-time graph is the...
Big question: how much can one graph tell you about a journey?
questions.a: A velocity-time graph gives acceleration (gradient), distance (area) and when the object is speeding up, steady or slowing.

questions.q: A car goes from 30 m/s to 10 m/s in 4 s. Acceleration?
questions.model: Formula: a = (v - u) ÷ t. Substitute: (10 - 30) ÷ 4 = -20 ÷ 4. Answer: -5 m/s² (a deceleration of 5 m/s²).

questions.q: Describe how to find speed from a curved distance-time graph at a given time.
questions.a: Draw a tangent (1); find its gradient (1).

questions.q: A ball dropped from rest falls 45 m (a = 10 m/s²). Speed on landing?
A train's v-t graph: 0 to 20 m/s in 40 s, constant for 60 s, stops in 20 s. Calculate the acceleration in each stage and the total distance.
questions.model: Teacher works stage 1: a = 20 ÷ 40 = 0.5 m/s²; distance = ½ × 40 × 20 = 400 m.

questions.q: Calculate the average speed of the train for the whole journey.
Describe a practical to investigate the motion of a toy car down a ramp (4SD0 1.5).
questions.a: Mark distances on the ramp (1); time with a stopwatch or light gates at each mark (1); calculate speed = distance ÷ time; repeat and average (1).
